content: On PHP 8.4.23 / Composer 2.10.1, the current manifest fails because Roave dev-master conflicts with illuminate/mail >=9,<12.60 and Laravel framework replaces illuminate/mail. An isolated manifest that removes Roave and enables config.policy.advisories block=true/audit=fail validates, but only resolves by selecting laravel/framework 11.x-dev due minimum-stability=dev. With minimum-stability=stable, all Laravel 11 releases are excluded by seven Packagist advisories. Do not treat the dev branch as a safe production workaround.
